notes.title: Version 1.1.2 (Patch)
notes.notes:
Changes in Version 1.1.2
-Fixed several issues with the Chinese (Traditional) localization.

notes.title: Version 1.1.1 (Patch)
notes.notes:
[b]Changes in Version 1.1.1[/b]
-Fixed issue where skipping a dungeon would not close the inventory.
-Fixed issue where an animation involving a statue would inappropriately repeat its animation.
-Fixed issue where a certain fan-favorite character would not animate upon re-entering the room.
-Enabled inventory in final room of the game so players can view collected Figurines and Pieces of Art.

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 (Patch)
notes.notes:
[b]Changes in Version 1.1.0[/b]
-Fixed an issue where new dialogue would not always trigger on the Counter’s door after Bubbles moves there.
-Added highlighting on crane grapple-hook point after correcting its position (Rising Hideout).
-Fixed an issue where the ‘chandelier-exit’ highlight wouldn’t appear (Schism).
-Adjusted the ‘chandelier-exit’ collider to be more generous.

notes.title: Version 1.0.9 (Patch)
notes.notes:
[b]Changes in Version 1.0.9[/b]
-Fixed an issue where updating to patch 1.0.6 from earlier versions could (rarely) cause a Schism soft-lock due to multiple keys being used on a single door.
-Fixed minor typos in the Japanese localization.

notes.title: Version 1.0.8 (Patch)
notes.notes:
Changes in Version 1.0.8:
-Fixed an issue where a ‘?’ would appear on the map (Schism) even after solving all puzzles.

notes.title: Version 1.0.7 (Patch)
notes.notes:
Changes in Version 1.0.7:
-Fixed an issue where the ‘padlock puzzle’ (Merchant Ward) would not display images properly.

notes.title: Version 1.0.6 (Patch)
notes.notes:
Changes in Version 1.0.6:
-Fixed a soft-lock involving the Curtain Crank in the Schism (new minor puzzle has been introduced).
-Fixed masking issue with a door found in the Schism (atrium).
-Fixed issue where a locked door in the Schism (B2, hub) would not be visible from the opposite side.

notes.title: Version 1.0.5 (Patch)
notes.notes:
Changes in Version 1.0.5:
-Implemented new check which grants missed Achievements (caused by previously fixed bug).

[b]Attention, all players who missed out on Achievements![/b]
[olist]
[*] Load your cleared save file.
[*] Trigger the final cutscene again; you may skip it by holding SPACE + S.
[*] All eligable Achiements should trigger.
[/olist]

Apologies for the inconvenience, and thank you for your patience!

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 (Patch)
notes.notes:
Changes in Version 1.0.4:
-Fixed issue where elevator (Tower of Vaeir) would load in different room upon force-quitting the game.

[b]Attention, all players currently stuck due to this issue![/b]
Please [url=https://homebearstudio.com/bug-report/]file a bug report[/url] and [u]attach your save file[/u]:
This allows me to fix your save file and send it back so you can continue playing without having to skip the dungeon.

notes.title: Version 1.0.3 (Patch)
notes.notes:
Changes in Version 1.0.3:
-Fixed issue where achievement progress would be reset.
-Fixed a couple of minor dialogue errors.
